posts.title: My mention monitor charges per search, not per month
posts.description: Brand monitoring tools start at $159 to $249 a month for a feed a solo founder reads once a day. Overhear bills per search instead: prepaid credits, six sources, Claude sorting the hits, and a connector so you can ask it questions instead of opening a dashboard.

posts.title: One year of Dioxus fullstack in production: the good, the painful
posts.description: After a year of Dioxus fullstack in production, the Rust code is the most boring part of my business. CI is the most exciting part, and not in a good way: a release build takes 90 minutes on a GitHub-hosted runner.

posts.title: My product demo is a config file now
posts.description: Interactive demo tools charge hundreds a month, and screenshot-based ones go stale the moment your UI changes. I stopped re-taking screenshots and turned my demos into a JSON file a CLI can re-record.
